_comment: WP09 booth Poly Haven jobs for Tools/images/wp09_ph_model.py (format of Tools/cc0/wp10_props.json plus screen / clock_zero / item_pivot / part_pivots). Coordinates are Blender source metres (front = -Y, up = +Z).

PH_TELEVISION_01.name: Television01
PH_TELEVISION_01.note: Booth CRT1-3 (vary scale 0.9-1.1). Submesh M_Television01_Screen = CRT glass with UV0 0..1 (u = viewer's right, v = up) for SG_CRTScreen + RT_CRTn (512x384).

PH_TELEVISION_02.name: Television02
PH_TELEVISION_02.note: Booth CRT4-6. Submesh M_Television02_Screen = CRT glass with UV0 0..1 (u = viewer's right, v = up) for SG_CRTScreen + RT_CRTn (512x384).

PH_WALL_CLOCK.name: WallClock
PH_WALL_CLOCK.note: Hands are children pivoted on the dial centre and set to 12:00. Time h:m -> HandHour local Z = -(h%12 + m/60)*30 deg, HandMinute local Z = -m*6 deg, HandSecond local Z = -s*6 deg (negative = clockwise seen from the front). Booth: 6:40 -> hour -200, minute -240; second hand twitches in place. Root pivot = back centre (wall plane); front faces +Z, so on the booth's far wall rotate 180 deg about Y. Glass submesh M_WallClock_Glass: Transparent; booth crack overlay T_WallClockGlassCrack_A (WP09) as its base map.

PH_VINTAGE_LIGHTER.name: SteelLighter
PH_VINTAGE_LIGHTER.note: Interrogator's steel lighter (bronze finish recoloured to worn brushed steel, brand and emblem removed). Lid child pivots on the hinge (rotate about local Z to close, ~+100 deg; verify sign), Wheel child spins about local X.

PH_MOUNTED_FLUORESCENT_LIGHTS.name: FluorescentBatten
PH_MOUNTED_FLUORESCENT_LIGHTS.note: Seven 0.91 m ceiling battens as separate children (single/twin/triple tube, open and diffuser). Booth uses FluorescentBatten_A (single tube) at (0, 2.95, 0.6); pivots = ceiling mounting face centre. Emission submesh M_FluorescentBatten_Glass: drive emission from the tube flicker curve.
